For a suspected vulnerability, use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/atomiclabs-tech/atomic-bridge/security/advisories/new).

## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Steps to reproduce

Give the smallest repeatable steps. Use placeholders for private values.

## Environment

- Atomic app version:
- Relay and plugin versions:
- Android version and phone model:
- macOS version:

## Evidence

Include relevant, sanitized error messages and test results. Remove credentials,
pairing data, relay addresses, phone content and other private information before
posting logs or screenshots.
